title: KLF6-driven macrophage-to-myofibroblast transition promotes PD-L1-mediated immune evasion in bladder cancer.
authors: Chen, Yuwen; Wang, Zihuan; He, Chengwu; Yu, Zhe; Zhang, Jinge; Jiang, Feifan; Zhang, Zicai; Li, Tanghua; Fu, Xinyang; Hou, Lina; Li, Fei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学分析发现KLF6驱动巨噬细胞-肌成纤维细胞转化并上调PD-L1，其中包含FIMO基序扫描和分子对接等蛋白-DNA互作相关分析，但核心是肿瘤免疫逃逸机制，非TF-DNA结合建模研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Although PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors are central to the management of advanced bladder cancer, most patients fail to achieve a meaningful response. While evidence ties MMT to fibrotic disease, its contribution to bladder cancer has yet to be examined. METHODS: We assembled and analysed several complementary data modalities-bulk transcriptomes from TCGA-BLCA (n = 408 tumour, 19 normal) and incorporated single-cell RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics (nine sections), and two independent immunotherapy cohorts (Kim 2019, n = 348; IMvigor210, n = 298)-to characterize MMT cells and construct an 18-gene MMT signature. Through spatial pseudotime analysis, in vitro overexpression, virtual knockout, FIMO motif scanning, and in vivo tumour models, we identified KLF6 as the key MMT driver. Virtual screening (L1000CDS(2)) and molecular docking (CB-Dock2) were performed to nominate drugs targeting the KLF6-MMT axis. RESULTS: MMT cells were present in bladder cancer, and the MMT signature was strongly associated with immunotherapy resistance (P = 0.037 for overall survival) and poor prognosis. KLF6 emerged as the key transcriptional driver of MMT, directly binding the ACTA2 proximal promoter. KLF6 overexpression promoted MMT, tumour growth, and PD-L1 upregulation in vivo (P < 0.05 for tumour weight, P < 0.01 for tumour volume), whereas virtual knockout suppressed core MMT effector genes. Spatial analysis revealed enhanced CD274 (PD-L1) expression by MMT cells, which may contribute to immune evasion through engagement of PDCD1 (PD-1) on tumour-infiltrating T cells (P < 0.001). Among the candidates identified by virtual screening, the cardiac glycoside Periplocymarin ranked first (overlap score = 0.375). Docking placed it in the KLF6 C3 pocket-the DNA-binding cleft-with an affinity of -6.5 kcal/mol, a pose consistent with competitive inhibition. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides the first multi-omics characterization of MMT in bladder cancer, identifies KLF6 as a previously unrecognized driver of this transition, and demonstrates that KLF6-driven MMT upregulates tumour PD-L1 through intercellular crosstalk. Furthermore, virtual screening and molecular docking identify Periplocymarin as a candidate compound targeting the KLF6-MMT axis. Our work thus connects KLF6-driven MMT to PD-L1-mediated immune evasion and suggests that disrupting this programme with Periplocymarin may provide a strategy to overcome immunotherapy resistance.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂是晚期膀胱癌治疗的核心手段，但大多数患者未能获得有意义的应答。虽有证据将MMT与纤维化疾病联系起来，但其在膀胱癌中的作用尚未被探讨。方法：我们整合并分析了多种互补数据模态——来自TCGA-BLCA的批量转录组（n = 408个肿瘤样本，19个正常样本），并纳入单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组学（九个切片）以及两个独立免疫治疗队列（Kim 2019，n = 348；IMvigor210，n = 298）——以表征MMT细胞并构建一个18基因MMT特征。通过空间伪时间分析、体外过表达、虚拟敲除、FIMO基序扫描和体内肿瘤模型，我们确定KLF6为关键MMT驱动因子。进行了虚拟筛选（L1000CDS(2)）和分子对接（CB-Dock2），以提名靶向KLF6-MMT轴的药物。结果：MMT细胞存在于膀胱癌中，且MMT特征与免疫治疗耐药性（总生存期P = 0.037）及不良预后密切相关。KLF6被确定为MMT的关键转录驱动因子，直接结合ACTA2近端启动子。KLF6过表达在体内促进了MMT、肿瘤生长和PD-L1上调（肿瘤重量P < 0.05，肿瘤体积P < 0.01），而虚拟敲除则抑制了核心MMT效应基因。空间分析显示，MMT细胞增强了CD274（PD-L1）的表达，这可能通过与肿瘤浸润T细胞上的PDCD1（PD-1）结合而促进免疫逃逸（P < 0.001）。在虚拟筛选确定的候选药物中，强心苷Periplocymarin排名第一（重叠分数 = 0.375）。对接将其置于KLF6 C3口袋——即DNA结合裂隙——亲和力为-6.5 kcal/mol，该构象与竞争性抑制一致。结论：本研究首次对膀胱癌中的MMT进行了多组学表征，将KLF6确定为这一转变的先前未被识别的驱动因子，并证明KLF6驱动的MMT通过细胞间串扰上调肿瘤PD-L1。此外，虚拟筛选和分子对接将Periplocymarin确定为靶向KLF6-MMT轴的候选化合物。因此，我们的工作将KLF6驱动的MMT与PD-L1介导的免疫逃逸联系起来，并提示用Periplocymarin破坏这一程序可能提供一种克服免疫治疗耐药的策略。
